name: Watatsumi Konoha
source:
Exorcist
A reliable and knowledgeable person. Practical and sometimes cold.
Fights with a staff that has a ring attached.
Unlike Setsuna or Sakuya, they are more skilled at controlling the environment through illusions or setting up barriers, rather than engaging in direct combat.

from www.cyberworks.jp
